title: Evolution Generators for Complex Parameters
summary: Theoretical studies on how quantum systems are affected by external factors are often formulated through parameter changes in the system's Hamiltonian. Beyond Berry connections and phases, which focus on specific Hamiltonian eigenstates, recent studies inspired by non-Hermitian quantum formalisms provide a framework for obtaining general state evolution generators for real-valued parameters.
